note: per-point interpolation loop (findInterval + lerp per i) -> vectorized pmin/findInterval + vector lerp; hot: n = output points

fixed_args.contour: local({p <- cumsum(runif(min(SZ, 500L)) + 0.1); data.frame(x = p, y = rev(p))})

old:
px <- numeric(n)
  py <- numeric(n)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    s <- target_s[i]
    segment_id <- min(
      findInterval(s, cumulative, rightmost.closed = TRUE),
      length(segment_lengths)
    )

    local_t <- (s - cumulative[segment_id]) / segment_lengths[segment_id]

    px[i] <- (1 - local_t) * x[segment_id] + local_t * x[segment_id + 1L]
    py[i] <- (1 - local_t) * y[segment_id] + local_t * y[segment_id + 1L]
  }
new:
segment_id <- pmin(
    findInterval(target_s, cumulative, rightmost.closed = TRUE),
    length(segment_lengths)
  )
  local_t <- (target_s - cumulative[segment_id]) / segment_lengths[segment_id]

  px <- (1 - local_t) * x[segment_id] + local_t * x[segment_id + 1L]
  py <- (1 - local_t) * y[segment_id] + local_t * y[segment_id + 1L]

note: t(apply(g, 1, ...)) doing pure arithmetic -> as.matrix + vector arithmetic (verified identical()); hot: rows scale with SZ
old:
g <- do.call(expand.grid, lapply(nd, seq_len))
  g <- t(apply(g, 1, function(x) offset + 1 + (x - 1) * (n + 1)))
new:
g <- do.call(expand.grid, lapply(nd, seq_len))
  g <- as.matrix(g)
  g <- offset + 1 + (g - 1) * (n + 1)
